scripts.generate:assets: npm run generate:sfx && npm run generate:store-assets
scripts.ios:prebuild: npm run generate:assets && expo prebuild --platform ios --clean
scripts.ios:eas:development: npm run generate:assets && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile development
scripts.ios:eas:preview: npm run generate:assets && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.ios:eas:production: npm run generate:assets && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.android:eas:preview: npm run generate:assets && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.android:eas:production: npm run generate:assets && npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile production
scripts.validate: npm run generate:assets && npm run verify:ios && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run simulate
scripts.export:android: npm run generate:assets && expo export --platform android --output-dir dist/android
scripts.export:ios: npm run generate:assets && expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/ios
